title: The Efficacy of Collagen Barrier Membranes in Regenerating Vertical Bone Defects: A Clinical and Cone Beam Computed Tomography (CBCT) Assessment
supports: Clinical study from the botiss Jason membrane (porcine pericardium) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “The study confirms the potential of the membrane technique, although the extent of the healing process is assessed at an extremely early stage. It can be safely concluded that it is not always necessary to place bone repair material under the barrier membrane to obtain good healing results” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
